name: Fractal
source:
In the year 2100 AD, the world was thrown into chaos by an attack by an unknown monster.
Of course, Japan is no exception.
The main character is a member of the fighting group "Fractal" that fights such monsters.
Although they were self-indulgent business, after receiving a certain request, a disturbing atmosphere gradually drifts out.
translation:
公元2100年，不明怪物的袭击令整个世界陷入混乱。
日本自然也不例外。
主角是对抗这类怪物的战斗组织“分形”（Fractal）的一员。
虽然他们平时行事散漫随性，但在接下某桩委托之后，一股令人不安的气息开始渐渐弥漫开来。
